name: Neuronic Clinical Dashboard

dispatch_notes.coder-frontend: Flutter web UI, GetX controllers, fl_chart dashboards, Sizer responsive layout
dispatch_notes.coder: General Dart logic, repositories, models, API integration
dispatch_notes.security-auditor: Cognito OAuth flows, API token handling, patient data access
dispatch_notes.ci-cd: GitHub Actions: S3 deploy + CloudFront invalidation, multi-env

guidance.stack_summary: Dart 3.x / Flutter 3.32.4 / GetX / AWS Cognito OAuth / neuronic_core / fl_chart / Sizer / S3+CloudFront
structure: lib/models/ — Data models with computed getters
conventions: MVC with GetX: Controllers → UI Screens → Repositories → Models
MainBinding registers services at startup (AuthService, Repositories)
Rx<T> observables for all reactive state
ci_cd: PR check: flutter analyze + build validation
Dev deploy: push to main → S3 sync + CloudFront invalidation
Stage/Prod deploy: push to release/v* → multi-env S3 + CloudFront
Auto semantic versioning from commit message (major/minor/patch detection)

custom_rules: Depends on neuronic_core (shared-core-lib) via git dependency
Env files generated from GitHub secrets at CI time, not committed
Social auth providers: Google, Apple via Cognito OAuth
